content.headline: How Does AI Answer You?
content.body: Sounding confident is not the same as being correct. AI does not look up facts. It builds an answer one small piece at a time, by guessing what comes next. That is why it can sound right and still be wrong.
bullets: It is broken into small pieces — more on this in the next lab
The model guesses the next likely piece, again and again
All these pieces together become the final answer
